_note: MVP mockup mapping (Phase 4): A1 competency → the catalog learnables that evidence it + the scenario levels that advance it. Hand-authored placeholder covering the shipped scenarios (bakery, restaurant); replace with the real Slovenian-A1 taxonomy (centerslo) when the team's materials arrive. Progress is read from the durable learner model — this is the ONLY learner-visible progress surface.

competencies.label: Greetings & everyday courtesy
competencies.descriptor: Greet at the right time of day, say please and thank you, close and leave politely, raise a toast.

competencies.label: Ordering food & drink
competencies.descriptor: Ask for what you want with 'Rad bi ___', 'Za mene ___', 'Jaz bom ___', 'Vzel bom ___' in the accusative.

competencies.label: Quantities & numbers
competencies.descriptor: Order by count and by weight — one, two (dual), half a kilo, decagrams.

competencies.label: Asking the price & paying
competencies.descriptor: Ask how much it costs, ask for the bill, and pay — by card or catching the spoken total.

competencies.label: Choosing & preferences
competencies.descriptor: Express a preference, point to what you want, ask for a recommendation, and compare options.

competencies.label: Describing & reacting
competencies.descriptor: Attach a describing word with correct agreement, react warmly, and close an order.
